The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both issues: only lower move counts replace a saved best, and unfinished sizes show `Best: none`. Added regression coverage for reloads, size changes, and snapshot imports.

Build/typecheck and all 140 unit checks pass. Browser run: 77 passed; one artwork test exceeded 30 seconds, then passed with a longer diagnostic timeout.

Changed files pass formatting. The full formatting check flags 13 untouched files.
